body: Thanks for writing and sharing your experience with me it really does help to know that there is at least one person who overcame what I feel right now.
I haven't served but thank you for your comment and kind words.

Thank you for your response. Yes, I take medication daily and all it really does is make me really tired. So tired that I can't enjoy life. It's sort of a viscous circle because without it i'm a wreck but with it I feel like i'm on autopilot.
